title: Remove Duplicates From Sorted Array
summary: Keep one occurrence of each value in a sorted array by editing its prefix.

contractDetails.constraints: 1–30000 integers in [−100,100], already in nondecreasing order. Serialize [k, ...first_k_values]. R returns list(k=..., nums=updated_vector).
contractDetails.output-checking: Call removeDuplicates(nums), then serialize [k, ...nums[:k]]. Check count and sorted prefix exactly. Ignore the suffix. R returns list(k=...,nums=...).

statement: Keep one occurrence of each value in a sorted array by editing its prefix. Return the number k of distinct values. The first k positions must contain those values in increasing order. Ignore the remaining positions.

examples.explanation: Three distinct values remain in sorted order.
Only the first occurrence is retained.

constraints: 1–30000 integers in [−100,100], already in nondecreasing order. Serialize [k, ...first_k_values]. R returns list(k=..., nums=updated_vector).
hints: Conceptual: Equal values are next to each other.
Directional: Use a read position and a separate write position.
Implementation: Write a value only when it differs from the most recently retained value. Return the final write position.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time and O(1) auxiliary space in mutable representations.
